learn.summary: A capacitor stores charge in an electric field. It passes changing signals and blocks steady DC.
learn.formula: Q = C × V   τ = R × C
tips: The code 104 means 10 × 10⁴ pF, which is 100 nF.
A ceramic capacitor has no polarity.
A 100 nF capacitor next to a chip filters fast noise on its supply.
